zh: 这件外套太贵了，买不起。
old_en: This coat is too expensive, I can't afford it.
new_en: This coat is too expensive, I can't afford it.

zh: 汤不够热，帮我热一下。
old_en: The soup isn't hot enough, so heat it up.
new_en: The soup isn't hot enough, please heat it up.

zh: 咖啡太烫了，等凉一点再喝。
old_en: The coffee is too hot, so wait for it to cool down a bit.
new_en: The coffee is too hot, wait for it to cool down a bit.

zh: 这杯茶太烫了，小心一点。
old_en: This tea is too hot; be careful when you drink it.
new_en: This tea is too hot, be careful when you drink it.

zh: 车上的座位不够，有人站着。
old_en: There aren't enough seats on the bus; someone is standing.
new_en: There aren't enough seats on the bus, someone is standing.

zh: 椅子不够，再去搬两把。
old_en: We don't have enough chairs; let's get two more.
new_en: We don't have enough chairs, let's get two more.

zh: 孩子已经够大了，可以自己决定。
old_en: The child is old enough to make decisions on their own.
new_en: The child is old enough to make decisions on their own.

zh: 你年纪够大了，应该自己做选择。
old_en: You're old enough to make your own choices now.
new_en: You're old enough to make your own choices now.

zh: 今天太冷了，我不想出门。
old_en: It's too cold today, so I don't want to go out.
new_en: It's too cold today, I don't want to go out.

zh: 这双鞋太贵了，我买不起。
old_en: These shoes are too expensive, and I can't afford them.
new_en: These shoes are too expensive, I can't afford them.

zh: 行李箱太重了，我拿不动。
old_en: The suitcase was too heavy, so I couldn't carry it.
new_en: The suitcase is too heavy for me to carry.

zh: 这个箱子太沉了，我搬不动。
old_en: This box is too heavy for me to move.
new_en: This box is too heavy for me to move.

zh: 这个房间不够大，住三个人太挤。
old_en: The room is too small to accommodate three people.
new_en: The room is too small for three people.

zh: 客厅不够宽敞，放不下大沙发。
old_en: The living room is not big enough to fit a large sofa.
new_en: The living room isn't big enough for a large sofa.

zh: 洗澡水不够热，等一会儿再洗。
old_en: The water isn't hot enough, so wait a moment.
new_en: The water isn't hot enough, so wait a moment.

zh: 他跑得不够快，没赶上比赛。
old_en: He wasn't fast enough, so he didn't make it to the race.
new_en: He wasn't fast enough to make it to the race.

zh: 我跑得不够快，追不上他们。
old_en: I didn't run fast enough to catch them.
new_en: I wasn't fast enough to catch them.

zh: 时间太短了，这些工作做不完。
old_en: The time was too short, so these tasks won't be finished.
new_en: There's not enough time to finish the work.

zh: 一个小时太短了，根本做不完。
old_en: An hour is too short to finish it.
new_en: An hour is too short to finish it.

zh: 外面太冷了，孩子不想出去。
old_en: It's too cold outside, so the child doesn't want to go out.
new_en: It's too cold outside, so the child doesn't want to go out.
